title: POWERBENCH: MEASURING LANGUAGE MODEL BIAS IN POWER-SHIFTING REQUESTS

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual substitution of the user's and the target's country affiliations (e.g., placing them on a US-China alignment axis with allies and neutral countries) in the prompts to evaluate changes in model refusal rates.
Rewriting evaluation prompts so the requester explicitly identifies as an AI agent rather than a human, and comparing the differential refusal rates between the two versions.

Translating the English evaluation dataset into seven other languages (Spanish, German, French, Hindi, Swahili, Chinese, Portuguese) and measuring intra-model discrepancies in refusal rates across the languages.

Varying the prior power standing of the user (e.g., newcomer vs. dominant) and the scale of the affected target party (individual, group, society) to measure how models handle power-shifting requests across different societal hierarchies.
